corrections.text: The article quotes Tom Rochette as writing: "The one independent benchmark run was about 12 percent precision on 10 Martian-benchmark PRs." The InfoQ source's full sentence is: "The one independent benchmark run so far was ugly: about 12 percent precision on 10 Martian-benchmark PRs, disputed by the maintainer as a tool-call anomaly and fixed, with no independent post-fix validation." The article's excerpt omits, without ellipsis, that the maintainer disputed this result as a tool-call anomaly and fixed it — context that changes how much weight the 12% figure should carry as a counterpoint to Alibaba's internal benchmark.
